title: grafana-ui public API surface is a hand-curated barrel, not generated
answers: Where do I export a new grafana-ui component so it's usable outside the package?
body: package.json `exports` maps three entry points: `.` → `src/index.ts`, `./unstable` → `src/unstable.ts`, `./internal` → `src/internal/index.ts`. `src/index.ts` (~547 lines) is a manually maintained barrel (e.g. `export { Icon } from './components/Icon/Icon';` at src/index.ts:20), loosely grouped by comments (forms, next-gen forms, visualizations, a 'Graveyard' section for deprecated-but-shipped components under `src/graveyard/`). There is no api-extractor step gating this (no api-extractor.json in this package) — anything not re-exported in src/index.ts is simply invisible to consumers, and anything added is exported with no automated check.
